name: Abort all jobs
description: Abort all jobs Cancels all running R2 Super Slurper migration jobs for the account. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs/abortAll
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs/abortAll
Cancels all running R2 Super Slurper migration jobs for the account. Any objects in the middle of a transfer will finish, but no new objects will start transferring.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Abort a job
description: Abort a job Cancels a specific R2 Super Slurper migration job. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs/{job_id}/abort
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs/{job_id}/abort
Cancels a specific R2 Super Slurper migration job. Any objects in the middle of a transfer will finish, but no new objects will start transferring.
Required: account_id (path); job_id (path)

name: Create a job
description: Create a job Creates a new R2 Super Slurper migration job to transfer objects from a source bucket (e.g. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs
Creates a new R2 Super Slurper migration job to transfer objects from a source bucket (e.g. S3, GCS, R2) to R2.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a job
description: Delete a job Deletes a completed, aborted, or errored R2 Super Slurper migration job. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs/{job_id}

name: Get job details
description: Get job details Retrieves detailed status and configuration for a specific R2 Super Slurper migration job. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs/{job_id}

name: Get job logs
description: Get job logs Gets log entries for an R2 Super Slurper migration job, showing migration status changes, errors, etc. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs/{job_id}/logs
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs/{job_id}/logs
Gets log entries for an R2 Super Slurper migration job, showing migration status changes, errors, etc.
Required: account_id (path); job_id (path)
Optional: limit (query); offset (query)

name: Get job progress
description: Get job progress Retrieves current progress metrics for an R2 Super Slurper migration job GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs/{job_id}/progress
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs/{job_id}/progress
Retrieves current progress metrics for an R2 Super Slurper migration job
Required: account_id (path); job_id (path)

name: List jobs
description: List jobs Lists all R2 Super Slurper migration jobs for the account with their status. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs
Lists all R2 Super Slurper migration jobs for the account with their status.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: limit (query); offset (query)

name: Pause a job
description: Pause a job Pauses a running R2 Super Slurper migration job. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs/{job_id}/pause
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs/{job_id}/pause
Pauses a running R2 Super Slurper migration job. The job can be resumed later to continue transferring.
Required: account_id (path); job_id (path)

name: Resume a job
description: Resume a job Resumes a paused R2 Super Slurper migration job, continuing the transfer from where it stopped. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs/{job_id}/resume
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/slurper/jobs/{job_id}/resume
Resumes a paused R2 Super Slurper migration job, continuing the transfer from where it stopped.
Required: account_id (path); job_id (path)
